scope: Actual raw comparator and denoised hero pixels viewed at 640x640, same display transform per metadata.
method: Intel Open Image Denoise RT, HDR, color-only
observations: Grain is substantially suppressed; rim, vessel base and metal edges remain well defined.
The stream is not erased by denoising, but its middle section remains weak-contrast.
Some fine receiving-surface detail is softened; transparent interfaces look smoother.
The pale lower fill still reads more solid/opaque than intended clear-resin presentation.
limitations: Only the hero view was denoised and reviewed at this stage.
A single-frame denoiser does not establish temporal stability.
